Remark
[Rong's generalization of Bochner's theorem]

Source: petersen:page-0334 ↗ def:pet-ch8-f-structure ↗ thm:pet-ch8-bochner-negative-ricci X. Rong generalized item 3 to show that a closed Riemannian manifold with negative Ricci curvature admits no pure $F$-structure of positive rank. The strategy mirrors the proof of item 3: one shows the function $f=\det [g(X_i,X_j)]$ from item 3 is a well-defined, sufficiently regular function on $M$ admitting a Bochner-type formula.
